P0_vanilla.technique: Textbook PINN: MLP on the 23 raw contract inputs plus a put flag; PDE residual in spot coordinates on the training box; soft payoff loss; Adam

P1_reduced.technique: Exact symmetry reduction: forward log-moneyness z, forward shares s_1..s_3, tau and (sigma_1..sigma_4, rho_12..rho_34); driftless PDE; put-call parity; far boundary at Levy values

P2_hard_payoff.technique: Hard terminal condition: c = Levy + tau * N(z, s, sqrt(tau), sigma, rho), so the payoff holds exactly and the network learns the correction

P4_adaptive.technique: Residual-based adaptive sampling (RAD) on the time-balanced residual: every 1000 steps keep 32,768 of 131,072 candidates drawn with probability proportional to |residual| / mean + 1, the residual weighted by tau / tau_max with collocation tau = tau_max u^2 (the two-stock P3 settings, kept without their own level)

P5_similarity.technique: Boundary-layer coordinate: the network also sees tanh(d / 3) with d = z / (Levy total volatility), the variable in which the near-expiry correction to Levy settles

P6_lbfgs.technique: Quasi-Newton polish: full-batch L-BFGS (strong Wolfe line search) warm-started from P5 on 16,384 RAD-selected collocation points

P7_nncg.technique: Second-order refinement: Nystrom-preconditioned Newton-CG (Rathore et al., 2024; from the 1D study) warm-started from P6

P9_envelope.technique: Enveloped correction: c = Levy + tau * phi(d_2) * N, which fades like the time value away from the strike; trained from a fresh start through the Adam, L-BFGS and Newton-CG stages

P10_anchored.technique: Anchored (hybrid) PINN, as in the 1D study: fine-tune P9 with the PDE residual plus reference prices at 4,096 anchor contracts of the training domain (their own seed), then L-BFGS

P11_permutation.technique: Stock-permutation augmentation: every anchor draw is presented under a random relabelling of the four stocks (shares, volatilities and correlations moved together), under which the price is unchanged; otherwise as P10, fine-tuned from P9
